title: Cardinal Cupich presents archdiocesan award to pro-LGBT ministry leader
description: Bringing you the news from a traditional Catholic perspective. title: Conservatives demand answers on gov’t aid to COVID jab-injured Canadians
description: OTTAWA ( LifeSiteNews ) — Multiple Conservative MPs are urging the Liberal Canadian government to clarify whether it plans to provide financial or other assistance to the thousands of people who say they were injured by COVID shots. Conservative MP Lianne Rood told fellow MPs on October 2 during a House of Commons debate that “Thousands, across many communities, have come to me over the years, expressing concern over how the government has treated them and those they know and love.” … The Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC) has stated that there were at least 58,000 known adverse events from individuals who received the COVID shot. However, this data has not been updated since 2024. PHAC recently took over the nation’s vaccine injury compensation program, changing the name from the Vaccine Injury Support Program (VISP) to the Vaccine Impact Assistance Program (VIAP). The agency had admitted that the COVID shots have caused harm to no less than 10,000 people. Allison, as reported by LifeSiteNews, says nationwide town halls should be held so that the true scope of the injections’ harms can be known.
